facts.claim: Check the venue name on a 2027 ticket: MEMI lists The Farmer Music Center at 6199 Kellogg Avenue with a planned spring 2027 opening, separately from Riverbend Music Center and PNC Pavilion at 6295 Kellogg Avenue. Riverbend’s entrance, seat-view and parking details should not be assumed to describe the new venue.
